messages:
jordan: Hey — running into a 400 from the tool call API. Error says: "Schema validation failed: unexpected character '\\t' in args JSON". Happens when user pastes payload from a Windows doc.

jordan: curl request below (redacted key) — the body is a JSON string passed as tool args:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{
  "tool": "invoice-extract",
  "args": "{\"file_path\": \"C:\\Users\\alice\\invoices\\inv1.pdf\",\t\"page\": 1}"
}'
```

jordan: Note the literal tab (\\t) inside the args string — the client pasted from Word and it brought along a few control chars. Also saw a leading BOM in one payload (\\uFEFF).

support-bot: Hi @jordan — I'm flagging this for support triage. Please include: SDK version, Content-Type header, and any raw byte dump if available. :eyes:

tanvi: Thanks — can you paste the exact raw args string (no redaction) and the SDK+OS? We need repro to escalate. Also, did you try sending the JSON as an object instead of a raw string?

jordan: SDK: js-client v2.3.1, Windows 11, copy/paste from Word 2019. Raw payload (hex-ish) attached: 
```
EF BB BF 7B 22 66 69 6C 65 5F 70 61 74 68 22 3A 22 43 3A 5C 55 73 65 72 73 5C 61 6C 69 63 65 5C 69 6E 76 31 2E 70 64 66 22 2C 09 22 70 61 67 65 22 3A 20 31 7D
```

jordan: That EF BB BF is the UTF-8 BOM. Removing it fixes parsing locally. But customers will paste from all sorts of editors. We should reject with a clearer error or auto-normalize.

samir: Thanks — this is helpful. Two separate issues: leading BOM + embedded control chars (tab). Server JSON parser chokes when args is a string containing control characters that aren't escaped. We should: 
- detect and strip leading BOMs on input (Content-Type: application/json)
- validate for unescaped control chars inside JSON string values and return 422 with a message like "unescaped control character in tool args: use \\uXXXX escape or send JSON object"
- add a helper in js-client to sanitize pasted payloads (trim BOM, replace stray \\t/\\r with \\u0009/\\u000D)

tanvi: Can you scope ETA for a server-side fix? We should also update docs and add a KB in support. The customer is blocked.

samir: I'll add a small middleware to normalize input and return a better error for cases we can't auto-fix. Plan: small patch in runtime repo to strip leading BOM bytes and run a quick scan for unescaped control characters inside string tokens. If present, return 400 with example of how to escape or a link to docs. Target: quick patch in 48h.

emi: For immediate workaround, tell customer to wrap args as JSON object (not a raw JSON string) or pre-run their payload through JSON.stringify in the client. Also we could add a server-side best-effort attempt to parse by first attempting to decode as UTF-8 ignoring BOM, then normalizing control chars.

jordan: Repro steps I gave to customer: 1) paste payload in Word -> copy 2) send via js-client v2.3.1 3) get 400 with "unexpected character". Alternative repro attached where I deliberately add a trailing comma inside the args object ("page":1, ) and get a separate "trailing comma" schema error. So multiple paste-related failure modes.

tanvi: Noted. I'll open an escalation ticket (ENG-INV-498) and mark P2 for now. Please drop sample payload and the hex dump in the ticket — include your curl.

samir: Added to my queue. For the middleware, can you include any failing request IDs from logs? That helps trace.

jordan: Request-IDs: rq_8a7f1c2a, rq_8a7f1c2b (two attempts). Sent both hex dumps. Thanks.

support-bot: Ticket ENG-INV-498 created and assigned to @samir. Reminder: add KB and quick support note about "remove BOM / escape control chars / avoid trailing commas". :thumbsup:

tanvi: I'll draft a short customer response: "Thanks — we identified paste artifacts (BOM, unescaped tabs/newlines, trailing commas). Temporary workaround: reformat args as JSON object or run JSON.stringify before sending. We're rolling a server normalization patch in ~48h."

jordan: Great, customer confirmed workaround works. Will follow up if anything else pops up. :+1:

samir: I'll post a short PR once I have tests for BOM strip + control-char detection. Will ping here when merged. :rocket:
